title: Magazine ad: Hunt for the Red Heifer - add your herd
summary: A photo of a magazine advertisement headed 'Hunt for the Red Heifer' inviting ranchers to add their herd to the hunt, listing the requirements (100% red, no scars, no wounds, no tattoos, no blemishes, no tags, no brands, never haltered), the $15,000 payment for the one selected to go to Israel, and a website to visit.

text.text: ADD YOUR HERD TO THE HUNT
Be part of something amazing! Help find the perfect red heifer!
– 100% red, no scars, no wounds, no tattoos – – No blemishes, no tags, no brands, never haltered –
$15,000 paid to the one selected to be transported to Israel. Top market price paid for all red heifers selected.
Add yourself to our system and we will provide information about how to contact us, when you have a calf that meets the criteria.

numbers.note: dollars paid to the rancher whose heifer is selected to be transported to Israel

pictures.description: Photograph of a magazine page lying open: a full-page advertisement with an orange-red sunset sky, a white silhouette of a calf standing on a grassy hill between a small Israeli flag and an American flag, and silhouettes of cattle on the horizon, with bold white and gold text on a dark brown lower half.
